record.title: FICC sponsoring member · sponsor side
record.sub: Participate through an account or member
kv: Legal basis
FICC GSD Rule 3A and applicable service terms
When it applies
A qualifying Netting Member seeks approval to sponsor eligible Sponsored Members.
Named firms

Citigroup Global Markets, Inc. (role documented); Mizuho Securities USA LLC (role documented); U.S. Bancorp Investments, Inc. (role documented); Barclays Bank PLC (role documented); Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC (role documented); The Bank of New York Mellon (role documented); Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. (role documented)
Who can use it
Eligible Netting Members approved by FICC as Sponsoring Members
Conditions

Establish the exact legal entity and qualifying membership. Confirm FICC sponsorship approval and the particular service. Identify the sponsored member, agreements, guarantee and applicable obligations.
The limit
Sponsor approval does not identify every sponsored customer or establish admission for a particular transaction.
Evidence
Citigroup Global Markets, Inc.: DTCC GOV2140-26 calls it a GSD Netting Member and states that it became a Sponsoring Member for the CIL Service effective 2026-04-16.
